scripts.deploy: npm run build:worker && cd worker && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:docs: npm run build:docs && cd gitbook && npx wrangler pages deploy out --project-name=9remote-docs
scripts.publish: npm run build:pkg && cd cli && npm publish
scripts.dev:desktop: cd desktop && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" npm run tauri dev
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:pkg && node scripts/buildDesktop.js && cd desktop && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" npm run tauri build
